text:
marcus: deploy-bot flagged the payments-hotpatch canary in eu-west1 — lots of pod restarts. logs show SIGTERM in preStop handler, not OOM. should we hold promotion and pin chart version? :thinking:

deploy-bot: Canary health degraded: 5/10 failed, auto-pause applied. recent release: chart payments-service v2.5.0+overlay-hotpatch.
jia: can you paste the preStop logs? curious if it's our graceful shutdown or the overlay init hook.
sara: quick idea — if the hotpatch overlay injected a preStop that ignores SIGTERM timing, pods might be killed by kubelet before cleanup. that would explain restart loop.
marcus: here's the relevant excerpt from the pod logs:

2026-03-21T10:04:12Z INFO starting shutdown sequence
2026-03-21T10:04:12Z WARN Received SIGTERM
2026-03-21T10:04:12Z ERROR preStop script failed: exit code 137
2026-03-21T10:04:13Z INFO healthcheck failing, liveness triggered

jia: exit code 137 usually OOM-kill, but stack shows SIGTERM then 137. Could be preStop spinning CPU / memory.
ops-oncall: we just saw a node pressure event in eu-west1-zone-b an hour ago. combined with a long-running preStop could push kubelet to kill.
lee: TL;DR: hotpatch overlay changed lifecycleHook timing and introduced a blocking step. We need to decide: rollback to v2.4.1, pin v2.4.1 for promotion, or patch overlay and re-run canary.
sara: rollback is fastest to restore capacity. patch+retest is safer long-term but slower. teams relying on this release will be affected by either path.
marcus: agree. proposal: pin chart to v2.4.1 for promotion pipeline, create hotfix branch to remove blocking step in overlay preStop, run a debug canary in a small subset (10%) once patched. schedule full promotion after 2 successful checks.
jia: +1. can we do a soft rollback (helm rollback) and keep the release notes intact? i can run rollback and then tag new chart commit.
ops-oncall: if we rollback, we should also set a temporary admission webhook to prevent the hotpatch overlay from being re-applied by the deploy-bot until fix is merged. otherwise deploy bot might retry.
marcus: good call. @deploy-bot can you pause promotions for release pipeline `payments` and block overlays until we flip the flag?
deploy-bot: Promotions paused for pipeline payments. Overlay injections blocked by tag `hotpatch-overlay:v2.5.0` until manual unblock.
lee: sample commands for rollback / verification — jotting down: 

# rollback to previous release (helm revision number may vary)
helm rollback payments-service 3 --namespace prod
# confirm pods stabilized
kubectl get pods -n prod -l app=payments-service -o wide
kubectl logs -n prod -l app=payments-service --tail 100

sara: also add a short note to release-notes: "rolled back v2.5.0 hotpatch overlay due to preStop blocking; working on hotfix" so customers see it.
jia: i'll open PR now: hotfix/remove-blocking-prestop, will include a unit test for the lifecycle handler and a shorter timeout. tagging @sre for review.
ops-oncall: i'll keep an eye on node pressure and evictions during the rollback window. please ping in #eng-oncall if things spike.
marcus: timeline: rollback in 15m, pin chart tag in CI, open hotfix PR, run 10% canary after tests pass, target full promotion in next change window (tomorrow 02:00-04:00 UTC) unless we can safe-promote earlier.
sara: ack. i'll draft the release note blurb and post to the release channel when rollback completes. :thumbsup:
jia: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/payments/pull/412 — hotfix + test. marking it urgent.
marcus: thanks everyone. once rollback completes, i'll update this thread with helm revision and pod status.
deploy-bot: Canary pause acknowledged. Blockers: none remaining.
marcus: rollback completed — helm rolled back to v2.4.1 (revision 3). pods stabilized (12/12 Ready). tagging this thread for postmortem and follow-up to ensure overlay lifecycle hook is fixed before re-promote.
sara: leaving release notes update in draft, will publish after we confirm canary test results.
ops-oncall: monitoring — no evictions seen for last 12m. marking as stable for now.
lee: action items summary — pin chart v2.4.1 in CI, PR for hotfix in progress, schedule canary test, postmortem on overlay injection process.
marcus: closing thread once release notes published and PR merged. thanks all. :rocket:
